text_block_list.text:
On this day, Light Hello negotiated with 
the academy and announced that a 
large-scale briefing would be held.

text_block_list.name: Gathered Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...An orientation for the Grand Live?

text_block_list.name: Gathered Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, that was super popular for a while, 
wasn't it? I think my friend joined in on 
the revival too.

text_block_list.name: Gathered Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Still, didn't that blow up into some kind 
of drama online? And having to do a live 
show... sounds like a total pain.

text_block_list.name: Gathered Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, is there even a need to do 
lives other than the Winning Live in the 
first place?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
For or against... no interest. A variety 
of opinions exist.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But I have to tell everyone. Once I do... 
they need to think about it for 
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... What a nuisance it is. The act 
of seeking consent, that is.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, the troublesome part is that 
without it, this experiment cannot be 
established.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
After all, we must verify it. ...Whether 
the "possibilities" that can arise in a 
live performance also extend to other 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Say, Tachyon. Back when you first invited 
me to join this plan...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"You said, 'I understand. That's why I 
want to reach out a hand to you,' didn't 
you?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. What about it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Does that mean you're also—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Shh... It looks like it's about to start.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Hello, everyone. My name is Light Hello.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Out of the blue, but... what does everyone 
really think about the Winning Live?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
My grandmother always told me, "A live 
performance is an occasion for gratitude; 
put your thanks into song for those who 
support your dreams."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
But there are girls who can't sing, aren't 
there? I mean, I used to be like that 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wished for a stage where 
everyone could express their gratitude 
equally, for the sake of Umamusume like 
them.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering... if there were no 
winners or losers, maybe everyone could 
just smile together.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Still, that's not true, is it? Because 
for us Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Winning Lives are special. I want them to 
remain a dream stage.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Still! I wanted to see you shine!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Even outside the spotlight, she kept 
working hard. Even when results eluded 
her, she wept alone and kept going.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to see her singing— the girl who 
left the stage without standing at center! 
Back then, I wanted to cheer for her with 
all my might!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Because I was your fan, Senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"This isn't as an Umamusume. This is 
purely my own selfishness as a fan!"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I want you all to perform a concert! I 
want a place where we can express all our 
feelings to everyone without holding 
anything back!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"Because to us, every single one of you... 
is the star."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
To us, nobody is just a backup dancer. 
Every single one is the main star...!!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I want to see everyone standing as the 
main stars on the stage of the Grand 
Live...!

text_block_list.name: Gathered Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: ...Still, is this really okay?

text_block_list.name: Gathered Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much you say it's "for the 
fans," then what would even be the point 
of the Winning Live...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Listen well! To convey our gratitude to 
the fans, the Winning Live format is 
undoubtedly the proper way!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Tachyon-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, is gratitude the only thing you 
wish to convey through your concert?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hello, and all our fans, expressed it! 
Feelings that went beyond just saying, 
"Congratulations on your win" or "Great 
run!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to stand at center." "You'll 
always be number one to me." "I want to 
keep watching over you forever."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"To me, you are my one and only star!" I 
just want to convey those selfishly 
heartfelt words!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —Then, what about your own egos?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Is all you want to convey on stage a 
simple 'I won, thank you'?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I am.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I want to tell them, 'I'm home.' And 
'Thank you for waiting for me.'

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Anything else?

text_block_list.name: Gathered Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...I want you to watch me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's quite quiet compared to your 
voice just a moment ago. Is that the 
extent of your feelings?

text_block_list.name: Gathered Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I want them to watch! Look at me! Follow 
me! I want to tell them to cheer for me 
and only me!

text_block_list.name: Gathered Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Hold on, you...

text_block_list.name: Gathered Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! I want to tell them it's not over 
yet! No matter how far behind you are, 
there's a goal you can't give up on!"

text_block_list.name: Gathered Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
I want to tell them that until then, no 
matter what happens, I want them to keep 
running alongside me...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh... Yes, that's the heat.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The Grand Live and the Winning Live 
are completely different in nature!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The Grand Live is nothing so noble. It's a 
place where your egos and the fans' egos 
clash!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't "Thanks to you" or 
"Congratulations." It was a clash of pure 
egos crying out: "I want to win," "Win!" 
"Watch me!" and "Don't you dare give 
up!"...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...A gathering of dreams.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It is a place where every Umamusume and 
fan can share their dreams, nurture them, 
and bring new possibilities to life.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, do you not recall? In a race, the 
resonance between fans and runners creates 
energy that can overcome even the 
impossible or reckless.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What if the Grand Live was capable of 
elevating that resonance to even greater 
heights and depths?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My current limits. If only I could become 
a device that generates explosive heat 
capable of changing everything.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... Quite alluring, isn't it? Now 
then, make full use of the stage!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Not for the fans, but for myself. Above 
all, to expand my own possibilities!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That passion should surely become your 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Gathered Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"...Can I really become strong? Is it okay 
for me to perform in the live show for 
that?"

text_block_list.name: Gathered Umamusume D
text_block_list.text: Um, can I... can I change myself too?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing special—it's just a place 
driven by ego. 'I have a message to 
share,' 'I want to get stronger'—whatever 
your reason for performing, it doesn't 
matter.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, there's our data too. Cases 
where times improved after performing in 
Winning Lives."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yeah. And also...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I have seen with my own eyes cases where a 
considerable 'change' took place.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Change happens to me, and to everyone 
else.

text_block_list.name: Gathered Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'll try joining in.

text_block_list.name: Gathered Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: ...Me too.

That tiny murmur gradually grew into a 
great wave, and the Umamusume gathered at 
the venue began speaking of choices.

—The speeches by Light Hello and the 
others had definitely made an impact.
